headline: Protests against World Cup spending in Brazil
content: The high costs associated with hosting the World Cup have sparked widespread protests across Brazil. With billions spent largely out of public funds, citizens demand better infrastructure like schools and hospitals rather than stadiums for cities lacking major football teams. Corruption allegations further inflame tensions among Brazilians who feel their government prioritizes international events over domestic needs.
